project_type: Monorepo with Python FastAPI service (project-ai) consuming tokens from TypeScript SHC platform
build_system: pip/setuptools for Python, pnpm workspace + turbo for TypeScript. Python service uses pyproject.toml.
verification_instructions: 1. Install Python dependencies: pip install -e '.[dev]' from services/project-ai. 2. Run pytest tests/ -v. 3. Verify all JWT alignment tests pass, including admin token acceptance and issuer validation.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for this JWT alignment task
environment_constraints: Python service requires JWT_SECRET and ADMIN_JWT_SECRET environment variables (same as SHC). Test tokens must be signed with these secrets using HS256 algorithm.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Standard pattern: make targeted changes, add tests, verify with pytest.
key_patterns: SHC TokenService (packages/auth/src/token.service.ts) uses jose library to sign tokens with JWT_SECRET (user) or ADMIN_JWT_SECRET (admin), sets iss='skillhubcore.in', tokenType='user'|'admin', aud='user'|'admin'. Python uses python-jose with HS256, validates in jwt.py decode_access_token() function. Config loaded from environment in config.py get_jwt_config(). Dependencies in dependencies.py extract user from Authorization header. Tests use conftest.py fixtures with AsyncMock and test_db_session.
relevant_files: packages/auth/src/token.service.ts (lines 82-94, 330, 357, 485 for issuer and secret references)
directory_structure: services/project-ai/ contains app/ (source) and tests/ (pytest tests). app/auth/ has config.py (env loading), jwt.py (token operations), dependencies.py (FastAPI deps). No .env.example exists yet. Tests use conftest.py for fixtures.
